entities.name: Bacterial ribosomal uS14
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed Pseudoalteromonas atlantica uS14 (UniProt Q15X60); 101 aa.
uS14 binds 16S rRNA and contributes to 30S ribosomal subunit assembly; reference notes a possible role shaping 16S rRNA at the A site.
Reference annotations include small ribosomal subunit, rRNA binding, structural constituent of ribosome, and translation.
